prompt: Can a 19-year-old driver in Texas be charged with full adult DWI (Driving While Intoxicated)?

options.text: No, anyone under age 21 can only be charged with the lesser offense of minor DUI
Only if the 19-year-old was operating a commercial freight vehicle on highways
Only if the minor was involved in a collision causing fatal pedestrian death
Yes, if the minor meets the adult definition of intoxication (BAC ≥ 0.08 or lost faculties)
